pub fn missing_parameter(name: &str) -> Error {
    Error::new(ErrorCode::MissingParameter, format!("`{name}` is required"))
}

impl<'a> Params<'a> {''',1)
s=s.replace('''        match names.iter().find(|name| !self.has(name)) {
            Some(name) => Err(Error::new(
                ErrorCode::MissingParameter,
                format!("`{name}` is required"),
            )),
            None => Ok(()),
        }''','''        match names.iter().find(|name| !self.has(name)) {
            Some(name) => Err(missing_parameter(name)),
            None => Ok(()),
        }''',1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='src/broker/message_commands.rs'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('''fn missing(name: &str) -> Error {
    Error::new(ErrorCode::MissingParameter, format!("`{name}` is required"))
}

''','')
s=s.replace('missing("','missing_parameter("').replace('|| missing_parameter(','|| missing_parameter(')
s=s.replace('use crate::request::Params;','use crate::request::{Params, missing_parameter};')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
